Class H3GridInitializer

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.data.H3GridInitializer
public class H3GridInitializer extends Object
Initializes the complete H3 grid for Earth at Level 8. Generates ~7.2 million hexagons covering the entire planet.

This is a one-time operation that seeds the database with all H3 cells. Real elevation and biome data will be filled in by subsequent ingestion steps.
